q: How does rooftop solar change a Bangladesh garment factory's Scope 2?
title: Rooftop solar at Bangladesh factories
short: Solar power you generate and use on site never enters Scope 2, so grid kWh fall and location based Scope 2 falls with them. Power exported under net metering is not subtracted from Scope 2. Keep the inverter readings and grid bills so brands can see both.
audience: Garment, knitting and denim factories in Bangladesh installing rooftop solar under net metering

ul: Solar generation from the inverter, monthly.
Grid import and export from the net meter.
The share of solar used on site, which is generation minus export.
Exported units as a reduction in Scope 2.
Renewable attributes you sold or that the utility claims.
A percentage renewable figure based on generation alone.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills and fuel invoices into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record per site. Grid factors outside India must be entered from the official source for the country and year, and are labelled with that source.
